title: SvgFeDisplacementMap
responsibility: Renders the native feDisplacementMap element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeDisplacementMap.attributes
inputs.description: Native feDisplacementMap attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeDisplacementMap.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feDisplacementMap element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeDisplacementMap
outputs.description: The actual native feDisplacementMap element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
